kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Locate heater bodies, compressor surfaces and restricted ventilation before choosing insulation and sleeving. Review the actual local wire temperature rather than the appliance room temperature alone.
copy.zh: 选择绝缘与套管前先标出加热体、压缩机表面及通风受限区域，审核导线所在位置的实际温度，不能只参考设备外部环境温度。

copy.en: Separate the current and termination requirements of heaters, motors and control sensors. Record startup loads and branch lengths before selecting conductor sizes.
copy.zh: 分别确认加热器、电机与控制传感器的电流及端接要求，选择导体规格前记录启动负载和各分支长度。

title.zh: 控制板版本与设备变型

copy.en: Use the appliance variant, board revision and connector cavity map to identify the harness. A matching connector shape or appliance family name does not establish the same circuit.
copy.zh: 依据设备变型、控制板版本和接口孔位表识别线束；接口外形相同或属于同一设备系列，并不能证明回路一致。

copy.en: Place grommets and fixing clips at sheet-metal entries, fan zones and moving assemblies. Check the assembly path so a finished connector is not forced through an undersized opening.
copy.zh: 在钣金入口、风扇区域和运动组件附近安排护线圈与固定卡扣，并核对装配路径，避免已端接接口被迫穿过尺寸不足的开口。

title.zh: 分支顺序与维修可达性

copy.en: Set branch order around the production sequence and removable appliance panels. Labels and connector orientation should let a service technician replace a branch without disturbing unrelated wiring.
copy.zh: 围绕生产装配顺序及可拆面板安排分支，标签与接口方向应便于维修人员更换局部分支，减少对其他布线的扰动。

copy.en: Agree pin mapping, continuity, terminal retention, routing and the project-specific electrical inspection plan. Record the approved appliance variant and drawing revision with the sample.
copy.zh: 约定针脚对应、导通、端子保持、布线以及项目适用的电气检验计划，并与样品一起记录已确认的设备变型和图纸版本。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
